_note: Friendly editorial copy grounded in this group's personas.json. These are jokes, not attributed quotes. Pick-specific copy requires the matching team and direction.

brian.default: Brian has probably read more about {team} than the rest of the group combined. If this works, everyone gets to act surprised by his football knowledge again.

picks.Stanford|O: Brian took the Stanford Over. The quiet researcher has left one very visible school logo on the research. The group is allowed to ask whether this was peer-reviewed by anyone outside Palo Alto.

david.default: David used to be a CPA. Now {team} is giving him numbers he cannot reconcile himself. If the pick struggles, at least the material is deductible from everyone's patience.

picks.Penn State|U: David needs Penn State to disappoint. A former CPA rooting for a shortfall: finally, an accounting problem he would welcome.

john_tamu.default: John has two football-obsessed sons and in-house scouting help. If {team} lets him down, the group should request the minutes from the family selection committee.

picks.Texas A&M|O: John took the Aggie Over. Somewhere in the selection process, a careful football analysis met a Texas A&M shirt and decided there was no need for further discussion.

john_wells.default: John makes financial plans for a living. This one depends on {team}. The group may request a revised risk questionnaire after the next uncomfortable fourth quarter.

picks.Virginia|O: John is a UVA man and a financial planner with a Virginia Over. The group should ask whether emotional attachment appears anywhere on the disclosure form.

zach.default: Zach turned an after-church football conversation into a website. Now {team} needs to justify the infrastructure. David has all the material he needs if it does not.

picks.Notre Dame|U: Zach wants Notre Dame losses, backed by a model he wrote himself. David is entitled to ask whether the model has an independent complaints department.

josh_b.default: Josh can build things, write sermons, and go fishing. Getting {team} to cooperate is the part of this weekend he cannot handle himself. Patience may be the transferable skill.

picks.Duke|O: Josh went to Duke Divinity and took the Duke Over. The group can debate whether this is scouting or alumni relations. Either way, he would appreciate a few more wins.
